beats.care: A 21-year era is over: 208 games, 126 goals. He still plays for his club.
beats.what: Messi played his last game for Argentina, scoring once and setting up two goals in a 3–0 win.
beats.why: At 39, he chose to step away two days after losing the 2026 World Cup final to Spain.

cards.body: Lionel Messi played his final game for Argentina on Tuesday night in Buenos Aires. Argentina beat Benin 3–0. Messi set up two goals and scored a penalty himself.
Over 21 years: 126 goals, the 2022 World Cup and two Copa América trophies.
cards.caption: games he played for Argentina

cards.body: He's 39. He made the decision on 21 July, just two days after Argentina lost this year's World Cup final 1–0 to Spain.
cards.title: why did he quit now?

cards.body: He's NOT retiring from football, only from the national team. He'll keep playing for his club. And Cristiano Ronaldo posted a tribute to his old rival after the match.

cards.q: How did Messi score his last goal for Argentina?
cards.why: Argentina got a penalty and Messi scored it in the 71st minute.

cards.q: Settle it once and for all. Who's the GOAT?
